title: Pokemon TCG Japanese Shedinja Mega Symphonia 072/063 Full Art Holo
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: The product is a rare Pokémon Trading Card Game card featuring the Shedinja character from the Mega Symphonia set. This Japanese-language card has a holographic finish and is part of the Full Art series, making it a highly sought-after addition to any collector's deck. With its unique design and rarity, this card is sure to be a prized possession for any Pokémon TCG enthusiast.
